title: HFO Suika Smash
description: An obsidian-and-gold reskin of the classic Suika/Watermelon merge game. Drop fruit, merge matching pairs, chase a bigger fruit and a higher score before the stack tops out. Built with plain JavaScript and the Matter.js physics engine. No install, mobile-friendly.
upstream_attribution: Based on moonfloof/suika-game (https://github.com/moonfloof/suika-game), Unlicense; original by tombofry. Matter.js under MIT.
